aboutGame.title: What is PixelLineage?
paragraphs: PixelLineage is an intense pixel-art action RPG combining classic roguelike mechanics, high-stakes permadeath, and deep lineage-based character progression. Venture into hostile biomes, battle unforgiving wilderness encounters, and forge generational bloodlines with inherited perks.

Whether you are mastering parry timing and stamina management in tactical duels, outfitting your adventurer with enchanted weapons and heavy plate armor, or advancing through specialized class tiers from Novice to Ultra Mastery, our wiki delivers comprehensive community-verified resources.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about PixelLineage mechanics, progression, and survival.

items.question: What is PixelLineage and what type of game is it?
items.answer: PixelLineage is a pixel-art fantasy action RPG combining classic roguelike permadeath mechanics, stamina-based combat, and ancestral progression where fallen adventurers pass perks to future generations.

items.question: What should beginners focus on first in PixelLineage?
items.answer: Beginners in PixelLineage should prioritize allocating early attribute points into Vitality and Endurance for survival, securing basic gear in safe outposts, and learning stamina pacing before taking on dangerous wilderness mobs.

items.question: How does character progression work in PixelLineage?
items.answer: Progression in PixelLineage develops organically through physical actions like sparring, sprinting, and casting. Meeting stat thresholds allows you to advance through class ranks from Novice up to Ultra Mastery.

items.question: How do I redeem active PixelLineage codes?
items.answer: To redeem PixelLineage codes, open the in-game settings or promo menu via the menu hotkey or gear icon, enter the exact code case-sensitively, and claim rewards such as trait rerolls, gold, and experience boosters.

items.question: How punishing is combat and death in PixelLineage?
items.answer: Combat in PixelLineage relies on stamina and poise management, where guard breaks leave you vulnerable. While permadeath resets active character progress, your bloodline preserves unlocked ancestral knowledge and traits.
